answer: The plume index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 350 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the harbor. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the kernel queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. That is 18 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
